Calls and alarms ring. Every other notification comes in silent, and still shows on the lock screen and in Glance.

Shows today\'s events, the weather and what is unread on the lock screen, from Calendar, Sky, Messaging and Email, and how many notifications the apps you choose have waiting. Without Calendar, it can read today\'s events itself if you turn that on. The utilities row, if you turn it on, can light the camera\'s lamp, show Almanac\'s moon, and ask the phone to start or stop the hotspot. It reads the lock screen only to see where its own items and the music controls are, and whether the PIN pad is up. It has no network access of its own.

It shows what Calendar, Sky, Messaging and Email hand it, and only when their own settings allow. Other apps that hand it lines stay off until switched on here. With notification access on, it counts the notifications of the apps you choose, and reads what they say only if you turn that on. Without Calendar, it reads today\'s events from Mudita\'s Calendar and, with calendar access, the phone\'s other calendars, only if you turn that on. The lamp, if you turn it on, uses the camera permission for the light only. The hotspot button asks the phone to start or stop sharing; Glance does not use the network itself.
The lock-screen overlay follows Katapult by gezimos, GPL 3.0.
